summary: One open table (Kelly et al., Dryad doi:10.6086/D1M97D, CC0, mirrored on Zenodo 6567737) gives species-mean glue droplets per mm, droplet volume, glycoprotein volume and axial-fibre cross-section for 15 orb weavers, i.e. mean bead spacing and core radius but not the pre-breakup coating radius, individual droplet positions, secondary-droplet sizes or viscosity. Other hits are adhesion-mechanics supplements. No repository dataset records the beading process or the instability wavelength directly; Dryad and Zenodo themselves are repositories, not datasets.
next_step: Combine D1M97D drop_mm and flag_CSA with per-species droplet dimensions from the Opell lab papers' supplements (figshare 33198870, dryad.t01q1) to get spacing/radius ratios; for onset and secondary beads, a new calibrated image series of freshly spun capture thread would be needed.
obstacles_confirmed: No public morphometric table of bead spacing exists.
Public images may omit fluid radius, viscosity, or time of formation.
Micrographs are concentrated on a few orb-weaver species and often illustrate rather than sample the thread.
